lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，地面在响
lines.en: I come step by step and the ground answers
My single eye never blinks
My antlers sweep the treetops
I lift a foot and snow comes up with it
I walk the treeline
My breath becomes white fog

lines.zh: 我每走一步，周围的树都静了
lines.en: Each step silences the trees around
I turn my way toward you
I snap a sapling underfoot
I lower my head, antlers forward
I stand and my single eye rolls
My breath comes out white
Snow hangs on my antlers
I set my feet in the snow

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一根黑树
lines.en: I stand still as a black tree

lines.zh: 我听见远处雪地里的脚步
lines.en: I hear steps far off in the snow

lines.zh: 独眼巨鹿的尾巴，扫过雪地。
lines.en: The deerclops tail sweeps the snow.

lines.zh: 我低下头，用角蹭了蹭地
lines.en: I lower my head and scrape with my antlers
Every bird around is gone

lines.zh: 我在等你走进我的范围
lines.en: I wait for you to step into my reach
My back arches and settles
Snow lands on my nose
I breathe out, a deep sound
The white of my eye has a yellow cast
I know exactly where you are
No hurry; the winter night is long
You're in my sight now
I lower my head so my antlers face you
You shouldn't be in this wood
My single eye won't look away

lines.zh: 你退一步，地面就响一下
lines.en: You step back and the ground answers
I'm slow, but I don't stop
This winter has a guest

lines.zh: 你的火把照不亮我这一边
lines.en: Your torch doesn't reach my side
Your heart is loud in this snow

lines.zh: 独眼一转，你就在视野里。
lines.en: My single eye turns and there you are.
I'll wait until you tire
Snow will cover your footprints

lines.zh: 我退了半步，角晃了一下
lines.en: I step back and my antlers sway

lines.zh: 我发出一声很低的长鸣
lines.en: I let out a long, low call

lines.zh: 我把头抬高，独眼转过来
lines.en: I raise my head and my eye turns
A gash opens in my hide
I pack the snow under my feet
I stop for a while
I don't call twice
I lower my head again
The more it hurts, the redder my eye burns.
I don't mean to give a step
You're holding fire
I don't like that little light
You hold it up and I daren't come close
When it dims, I'll come over
You carry something warm
Put that thing down
I smell fat
Let it burn a little longer
This one eye of mine fears light
When the lamp dies, I won't be here
You hit my leg like a wall
Not even the snow on me shifts
My antler sweeps you back
You slip under me

lines.zh: 我的脚落下来，雪坑很深
lines.en: My foot comes down into a deep pit of snow
I shove you aside with my antlers

lines.zh: 我们一起撞倒了一棵小树
lines.en: We knock over a sapling together
I knock you away like a chunk of ice.
That would count as light

lines.zh: 我站在那里，你自己弹开
lines.en: I stand and you bounce off on your own

lines.zh: 林子里传来低沉的一声
lines.en: A low sound comes from the wood
Another steps out from behind the trees
Its antlers are longer than mine

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，雪落在背上
lines.en: We stand side by side, snow on our backs

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸合成一片雾
lines.en: Our breath becomes one fog

lines.zh: 它把眼睛转向我，只有一只
lines.en: It turns its single eye to me

lines.zh: 我们一起走进更深的林子
lines.en: We walk into the deeper wood

lines.zh: 脚下的雪很厚，走路很轻
lines.en: The snow is thick and our steps soft

lines.zh: 这一片林子以后有两个
lines.en: Two of us in this wood now
The winter has a long way to go
I lower my head and take it

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，没什么味道
lines.en: I bite it; it has no taste
I flick it aside with my antlers
It catches on my antlers
I shake my head until it drops
I pin it under a hoof
There's more under the snow
No use to a stag like me
I stamp it into the snow
I turn and walk slowly off
You raised the torch
I turn my eye on you

lines.zh: 我的角低下来，对着你的方向
lines.en: My antlers come down toward you
There's little prey in a winter night
I've taken my first step

lines.zh: 我的脚步比刚才快一点
lines.en: My pace is a little quicker
You can't leave this snowfield
My one eye has you
A seven-block shadow covers you.
The snow will keep your tracks
I'll take it step by step
Listen; my steps fall heavy
At this distance I won't miss
You can't drive me back

lines.zh: 我很清楚你还有多少力气
lines.en: I know exactly how much you have left
Let it start right now
I lower my head to my chest
There's only one sound on the snowfield
My antlers carve lines in the snow
There's no other way

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，一步一步
lines.en: I come at you step by step
My single eye hasn't blinked
You retreat and the snow gets churned
You hold fire; I keep my distance
But fire always burns out
I wait for it to shrink
My antlers stay leveled at you

lines.zh: 我这独眼一转，雪地都在抖。
lines.en: One turn of my eye shakes the snow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步让雪地一颤一颤
lines.en: My steps make the snowfield shudder
You hear my antlers scrape a tree

lines.zh: 我一步步把你赶向空地
lines.en: I drive you toward the open, step by step
The open offers no cover
I press you to the treeline
The trees will block you
I stop and take a breath
That breath is white in the night
I begin walking again
You have a few steps left
Why should I hurry at all
I only need to keep walking
My forked antlers go straight for your knees.

lines.zh: 这一下把你掀翻在雪里
lines.en: That flips you into the snow
I bring a forefoot down
My foot leaves a pit in the snow
My antlers sweep your flank
You're thrown a distance

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，树被撞断
lines.en: I miss and snap a tree
I lower my head and ram again

lines.zh: 你挡住了，可整个人往后滑
lines.en: You block and still slide backward
I come down on you from above

lines.zh: 我的重量就是我的杀招
lines.en: My weight is the kill
You're pressed into the snow
I lift a foot for another

lines.zh: 这一下我把全身重量压上
lines.en: That one carried all my weight

lines.zh: 林子里多了一个高大的影子
lines.en: A tall shape stands among the trees
My single eye catches the light first
Deep prints begin to mark the snow

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，角先出来
lines.en: I come from behind the trees, antlers first
The wind stops, and the snow
My white breath is large

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在夜里传得远
lines.en: My steps carry far in the night
Snow falls off the branches I brush
I survey the open ground first
Winter brought me here
I lift a foot and set it down
This wood has a master now

lines.zh: 我的角撞到树干，雪崩下来
lines.en: My antlers hit a trunk and snow cascades
I stop and move only my eye
You're by the fire; I see you
I come on, sinking with each step
The snow sounds under me
This night won't be quiet

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的人还大
lines.en: My shadow is bigger than you
I've come; don't put out the light

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我猛地甩头
lines.en: Fire catches my coat and I shake my head hard

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，角先撞地
lines.en: I slide down a slope, antlers hitting first

lines.zh: 冰水灌进我鼻子，我猛抬起头
lines.en: Ice water fills my nose and I jerk my head up

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了雪地，我被埋了半截
lines.en: The blast turns the snowfield and buries me half
An arrow plants itself in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的独眼发白
lines.en: That force whitens my eye

lines.zh: 这个冬天没什么可吃的
lines.en: There's little to eat this winter

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，四腿都弯了
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and all four legs bend
No snow below, and no ground
